infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Urban Helpers needs your location to show your professional's route and find nearby helper services.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Urban Helpers uses your location to keep track of service requests and professional arrival.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Urban Helpers tracks your daily steps and physical activity.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Urban Helpers connects to your smartwatch to sync health data like heart rate, steps, and activity metrics.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Urban Helpers needs Bluetooth to sync your wearable device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Urban Helpers requires access to the camera to upload profile and health record photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Urban Helpers requires access to your photo library to select profile and health document pictures.
